# WNBA Finals Game 6 - Valkyries at Dream, Thu Oct 29, 12:30 PM ET

Golden State leads 3-2 (won G4 and G5, G5 64-55; Dream shot 29%). Dream -4.5 (-112), ML -185 / Valkyries +154, total 146.5-147.5. Dream: Brionna Jones out, Te-Hina Paopao questionable, Allisha Gray limited by a hand injury. Atlanta 17-4 at home in the regular season; Golden State won the season series 3-0.

- Dream ML/spread: Dimers 71.2% Dream vs 64.9% implied, but after the 0.58 factor it is 62.3% - below the price. Covers capper on Dream -3.5 (line now 4.5). Pass.
- **Lean Under 147.5:** series has been low-scoring (G5 combined 119), Atlanta's frontcourt depleted (Jones out) and Gray hurt; SI likes the Valkyries team-total under. No model projection on the total and no opener confirmed, so not a bet.
